story: An icon of the skies, the Sri Lanka Grey Hornbill (Ocyceros gingalensis) is a species from the Bucerotidae family. It thrives in Evergreen forest; deciduous woodland; areas with dense climbing plants; gardens; and plantations, where it interacts with its environment in unique ways. With a conservation status of Least Concern (LC), the Sri Lanka Grey Hornbill is a focus for conservationists worldwide. Understanding the needs of the Sri Lanka Grey Hornbill helps us better comprehend the challenges facing our planet's wildlife. This poster is a celebration of the Sri Lanka Grey Hornbill, a bird that inspires wonder and highlights the critical importance of conservation efforts.
